reason: Modify_pending_order_items requires new_item_ids to list a replacement item of the same product (different option) for each item_id being modified; it does not support removing items from an order without replacement. The candidate call passes item_ids with 3 entries but new_item_ids as an empty list, which already failed once with 'The number of items to be exchanged should match.' The user's actual intent (delete 3 items, keep 2, no substitutes) is not a supported modification under policy — modify only covers swapping to a different option of the same product type, not deletion/removal of items from an order. Proceeding would either error again or require fabricating substitute item ids not provided by the user or tools, which the policy prohibits ('should not make up any information...not provided by the user or the tools').
policy_references: For a pending order, each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option.
This action can only be called once...
You should not make up any information or knowledge or procedures not provided by the user or the tools
